elements.text: 1. 产品概述 / 1. Product Overview
SAP 登录管理器是一款免安装的 Windows 桌面工具，用于集中管理 SAP Logon 中的系统连接与登录凭据，实现「双击即登录」，免去每日重复输入账号密码。
SAP Logon Manager is a portable Windows desktop utility that centralizes SAP Logon connections and credentials, enabling one-click sign-on and eliminating repetitive manual logins.
核心特性：

items: 单文件绿色版：双击即用，不写注册表、不安装运行时 / Portable single executable; no registry writes, no runtime install
自动读取本机 SAP Logon 配置，一键同步 / Auto-reads local SAP Logon configuration with one-click sync
凭据经 AES-256-GCM 加密，仅保存在本机 / Credentials protected with AES-256-GCM and stored locally only
支持批量登录、分组收藏、事务码直达、脚本绑定、导入导出 / Batch logon, groups & favorites, transaction shortcuts, script binding, import/export
支持 Windows Hello 与 Windows 账户密码解锁主密码 / Windows Hello and Windows-account-password unlock
支持便携模式，整包拷贝即可换机使用 / Portable mode for migration to another PC

elements.text: The tool only invokes SAP's official executables (sapshcut.exe / saplogon.exe). It does not modify SAP GUI files nor write back to SAP Logon configuration.
2. 环境要求 / 2. System Requirements

pairs.value: Windows 10 / 11（64 位）/ Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
SAP GUI for Windows 7.40 及以上（8.0 实测通过）/ 7.40 or later (verified on 8.0)
普通用户即可，无需管理员权限 / Standard user; administrator rights not required
无需联网；仅在登录 SAP 时访问你的 SAP 服务器 / No Internet access needed; only contacts your SAP server at logon

elements.text: 本工具仅调用 SAP 官方的 sapshcut.exe / saplogon.exe，不修改 SAP GUI 任何文件，也不会回写你的 SAP Logon 配置。
This tool only invokes SAP's official sapshcut.exe / saplogon.exe. It does not modify SAP GUI files and never writes back to your SAP Logon configuration.
3. 快速上手 / 3. Getting Started
首次使用约需 1 分钟：

items: 双击 SAP登录管理器.exe 启动程序。/ Double-click SAP登录管理器.exe to launch the program.
设置主密码（至少 6 位）；建议勾选「记住主密码」以便下次免输。/ Set a master password (at least 6 characters); optionally enable “Remember master password”.
点击右上角「自动获取现有配置」（快捷键 F5），扫描本机 SAP Logon 并列出全部系统。/ Click “Sync from SAP Logon” (F5) to scan and list all systems.
双击某个系统（或点其「登录」按钮），填入账号密码，勾选「保存密码并自动登录」后保存。/ Double-click a system (or click “Log on”), enter credentials and check “Save password and log on automatically”.
之后登录只需双击，即直达 SAP 系统界面。/ From then on, a double-click opens the SAP system directly.

elements.text: 主密码遗忘后，已保存的凭据无法恢复（这是加密的设计，不是缺陷）。请在「设置 → 数据与诊断」中定期导出加密备份；也可启用 Windows Hello 或使用 Windows 账户密码解锁（见第 9 章）。

If the master password is lost, stored credentials cannot be recovered by design. Export encrypted backups regularly in Settings → Data & Diagnostics; alternatively enable Windows Hello or Windows account password recovery (see Chapter 9).
4. 主界面说明 / 4. Main Window
主界面由顶部工具栏（搜索、自动获取现有配置、批量登录、新增连接、排序）、左侧分组导航（全部系统 / 收藏 / 自定义分组）、中部系统列表与底部状态栏组成。
The main window consists of a top toolbar (search, sync, batch logon, new connection, sorting), a left navigation pane (All Systems / Favorites / custom groups), the system list and a status bar.
4.1 系统列表 / 4.1 System List
每行展示：环境徽标（DEV 绿 / QAS 橙 / PRD 红）· 系统名 · SID · 连接方式 · 上次登录时间 · 客户端 · 连通性圆点 · 收藏星标 · 登录按钮。行内蓝色文字为该系统当前的默认登录账号；账号绑定姓名后显示为「姓名 (账号)」。

Each row shows: environment badge (DEV green / QAS orange / PRD red), system name, SID, connection mode, last logon time, client, connectivity dot, favorite star and the logon button. Blue text is the default account; with a display name bound it renders as “Name (Account)”.
列表条目与分组均支持长按拖拽排序（见 9.5）。
Items and groups support press-and-drag reordering (see 9.5).
4.2 环境徽标 / 4.2 Environment Badges
按系统名称与 SID 自动推断环境类型（DEV / QAS / PRD），也可在「编辑连接」中手动指定。生产系统（PRD）默认在登录前弹出二次确认，防止误入生产。

The environment type (DEV / QAS / PRD) is inferred from the system name and SID, and can be set manually in “Edit Connection”. Production systems require a confirmation before logon to prevent mistakes.
4.3 连通性指示 / 4.3 Connectivity Indicator
绿色 = 可连通；红色 = 不可达；黄色 = 检测中。经 Router 的系统探测 Router 端口（3299），负载均衡系统探测消息服务器端口（3600）。
Green = reachable; red = unreachable; yellow = probing. Router-based systems probe the Router port (3299); load-balanced systems probe the message server port (3600).
5. 配置同步 / 5. Configuration Sync
点击「自动获取现有配置」或按 F5，程序会重新读取 %APPDATA%\SAP\Common\SAPUILandscape.xml（含 <Includes> 引用的文件；旧版安装自动回退读取 saplogon.ini），并与本地清单按下列规则合并：

Click “Sync from SAP Logon” or press F5. The program re-reads %APPDATA%\SAP\Common\SAPUILandscape.xml (including <Includes> references; older installations fall back to saplogon.ini) and merges it with the local list using these rules:

pairs.value: 追加到列表并标注 NEW，保留你已有的分组与收藏 / Appended and tagged NEW; existing groups and favorites preserved
更新 host、端口、Router 与备注；凭据、收藏、分组、脚本绑定全部保留 / Connection parameters updated; credentials, favorites, groups and script bindings retained
同步新名称并提示「已更名」，避免按名称定位失配 / Name synchronized with a notice; prevents name-based mismatch
标注「失效」并置灰置底，不删除条目；凭据仍在，可手动删除 / Marked invalid and greyed out; entries and credentials kept until deleted manually
自己手工添加的连接完全不受同步影响 / Manually added connections are never touched by sync

elements.text: 每次同步前自动创建快照，可在「设置 → 数据与诊断 → 回滚到最近快照」还原。配置文件读取异常时不会覆盖旧清单，只报错、不清空列表。程序启动时会静默同步一次；SAP Logon 配置变化时也会自动同步。

A snapshot is taken before every sync and can be restored in Settings → Data & Diagnostics. If the configuration file cannot be parsed, the old list is kept and an error is reported — the list is never cleared. The program also syncs silently at startup and whenever SAP Logon configuration changes.
6. 批量登录 / 6. Batch Logon
用于掉线后一键拉起多个系统：

items: 在列表左侧勾选多个系统（可跨分组，配合搜索框快速筛选）。/ Tick multiple systems in the list (across groups; combine with search).
点击底部「登录选中 (n)」或顶部「批量登录」。/ Click “Log on selected (n)” at the bottom or “Batch Logon” at the top.
弹窗中点「开始登录」，逐条显示 成功 / 需手输 / 失败 / 跳过，可随时中止。/ Press “Start”; each item reports success / manual / failed / skipped; the run can be aborted at any time.
默认顺序执行、间隔 3 秒（设置中 1–10 秒可调），避免会话争抢 / Sequential execution with a 3-second interval (adjustable 1–10 s) to avoid session contention
勾选「跳过不可达系统」可自动跳过探测失败的条目 / Option “Skip unreachable systems”
失败不会自动重试，避免账号被锁定 / Failed items are not retried automatically (prevents account lockout)
结束后可「复制结果」留档 / Results can be copied for the record

elements.text: 7. 凭据与账号管理 / 7. Credentials & Account Management
7.1 多账号（每客户端上限 8 个） / 7.1 Multiple Accounts (up to 8 per client)
同一「系统 + 客户端」下最多可保存 8 个账号，适合多人共用一台机器、或一人在多个客户端有不同账号的场景。右键连接 →「编辑凭据…」进行管理；第一个保存的账号自动成为默认账号。

Up to 8 accounts can be stored per system-and-client pair — useful for shared machines or multiple clients. Manage them via right-click → “Edit Credentials…”. The first saved account becomes the default.

pairs.value: 点「新增账号」，填写账号（可绑定姓名）与密码后保存 / Click “Add account”, fill in account (optionally a display name) and password
选中账号点「设为默认」，同客户端其它账号自动取消默认 / Select an account and click “Set default”; other accounts on the same client are deselected
删除的是默认账号时，自动把剩余账号提升一个为默认，不会出现无默认状态 / When the default is deleted, the next remaining account is promoted automatically
客户端下拉一改，账号列表随之切换（每个客户端各自最多 8 个）/ The account list follows the selected client (8 per client)
第 9 个账号会被拒绝并提示，需先删除不用的账号 / A 9th account is rejected with a prompt

elements.text: 7.2 账号姓名字段 / 7.2 Display Name
账号可绑定「姓名（可选）」。保存后，登录菜单、主列表「上次登录」等处统一显示为「姓名 (账号)」（无姓名时仅显示账号），便于区分同一客户端下的多个账号。
An optional display name can be bound to each account. Wherever the account appears (logon menu, “last logon” column, etc.) it renders as “Name (Account)”, or just the account when no name is set.
7.3 登录时选账号 / 7.3 Choosing an Account at Logon

items: 右键连接，菜单显示「登录（默认 XX）」与各账号的「以 XX 登录」子项。/ Right-click a connection: “Log on (default XX)” plus one entry per account.
双击行或点「登录」→ 使用默认账号。/ Double-click or “Log on” uses the default account.
点「以 XX 登录」→ 使用指定账号。/ “Log on as XX” uses that specific account.
批量登录始终使用各系统的默认账号。/ Batch logon always uses each system's default account.

elements.text: Saved passwords can also be updated here at any time; the change is written to the encrypted vault immediately.
8. 安全机制 / 8. Security Mechanisms

pairs.value: 主密码经 PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256（20 万次迭代）派生密钥，凭据以 AES-256-GCM 认证加密存储于 vault.dat / Credentials stored in vault.dat, encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (200,000 iterations) derived key
可选。使用 Windows DPAPI 封装，仅当前 Windows 账户可解密；换电脑后需重新输入主密码 / Optional; wrapped with Windows DPAPI and bound to the current Windows account
默认 10 分钟无操作自动锁定（可调 0–720 分钟），锁定后需重新验证 / Locks after 10 minutes of inactivity (adjustable 0–720 min)

优先生成临时 .sap 文件交 SAP 官方程序执行，密码不出现在命令行；文件用后立即覆写并删除 / A temporary .sap file is passed to the official SAP executable; the password never appears on the command line; the file is overwritten and deleted after use
仅记录事件与错误码，从不记录密码 / Events and error codes only — passwords are never logged

elements.text: 8.1 自动填表安全底线 / 8.1 Auto-Fill Safety Rules
密码仅在 SAP 登录框出现时注入，填入前执行三重校验，任一不满足即放弃填表：

items: 只认 SAP 进程：窗口必须属于 SAP 安装目录下的 saplogon.exe / sapgui.exe / sapshcut.exe。/ SAP processes only: the window must belong to saplogon.exe / sapgui.exe / sapshcut.exe under the SAP installation directory.
只认本次目标：窗口标题中的 SID 与客户端必须与本次登录一致，防止把 PRD 的密码填进其它系统。/ Current target only: the SID and client in the window title must match this logon attempt.
一次登录最多填一次：再次弹框通常意味着密码已被拒绝，重复填写只会增加锁号风险。/ At most one fill per logon: a repeated dialog means the password was rejected; retrying risks locking the account.

elements.text: The fill uses standard Win32 messages (WM_SETTEXT / BM_CLICK) with a read-back verification. No DLL injection, no keystroke simulation and no global hooks are involved.
登录采用「临时 .sap + 自动填表」而非命令行 -pw，是因为 SAP GUI 7.40 PL1 起 .sap 的密码字段被官方禁用（SAP Note 146173），且命令行方式会把密码暴露在进程命令行中。

The “temporary .sap + auto-fill” approach is used because the .sap password field has been officially disabled since SAP GUI 7.40 PL1 (SAP Note 146173), and command-line passwords are exposed in the process command line.
9. 便捷功能 / 9. Productivity Features
9.1 Windows Hello 解锁 / 9.1 Windows Hello Unlock
在「设置」中启用 Windows Hello 后，解锁主密码可使用人脸、指纹或 PIN，无需键入主密码。
With Windows Hello enabled in Settings, the master password can be unlocked by facial recognition, fingerprint or PIN.
9.2 Windows 账户密码恢复 / 9.2 Windows Account Password Recovery
忘记主密码时，可在解锁界面使用当前 Windows 账户的登录密码完成验证解锁（需此前已成功保存过主密码）。
If the master password is forgotten, unlock with the current Windows account password (requires a previously saved master password).
9.3 便携模式 / 9.3 Portable Mode
在「设置 → 数据与诊断」点「切换为便携模式」，程序会把数据目录复制到 exe 同级的 data\ 文件夹并重启；此后把「exe + data」整体拷贝到另一台装有 SAP GUI 的电脑即可直接使用。

Click “Switch to portable mode” in Settings → Data & Diagnostics. Data is copied to a data\ folder next to the executable and the program restarts. Copy the exe plus the data folder to another PC with SAP GUI installed and run directly.
9.4 密码可见性 / 9.4 Password Visibility
所有密码框右侧均有小眼睛按钮：按住即显示明文，松开或移开鼠标立即隐藏，有效防止肩窥。
Every password box has an eye button: hold it to reveal the plaintext, release (or move away) to hide it immediately — effective protection against shoulder surfing.
9.5 长按拖拽排序 / 9.5 Drag-to-Reorder
在列表中长按某个系统或分组约 0.4 秒后拖动，即可调整顺序；程序会实时重排并写回排序值，非自定义排序模式下自动固化为自定义顺序。
Press and hold a system or group for about 0.4 seconds, then drag to reorder. The new order is written back immediately and promoted to a custom order automatically.
9.6 单实例与占用提醒 / 9.6 Single Instance & Occupancy Prompt
程序为单实例。若已有实例在运行，再次启动时会提示：切换到已运行的窗口、或一键结束占用进程后重启、或退出。
The program runs as a single instance. Launching it again offers to switch to the running window, terminate the occupying process and restart, or exit.
9.7 版本标识 / 9.7 Version Tag
状态栏左下角显示当前构建版本，格式为 GURURU+YYYYMMDDHHMM（取自构建时间，精确到分钟），「关于」窗口中同步展示。
The status bar (bottom-left) shows the build version in GURURU+YYYYMMDDHHMM format (build timestamp, minute precision), also displayed in the About window.
10. 登录机制与故障排查 / 10. Logon Mechanism & Troubleshooting
10.1 登录链 / 10.1 Logon Chain

items: 生成临时 .sap 文件：含显示名、连接串与账号（不带密码）。/ Generate a temporary .sap file with description, connection parameters and account (no password).
调用 sapshcut.exe -open，由 SAP 按显示名从本机 landscape 精确定位系统。/ sapshcut.exe -open lets SAP resolve the system by its display name in the local landscape.
SAP 弹出登录框（标题即系统显示名）。/ SAP shows the logon dialog titled with the system display name.
程序校验窗口来源后自动填入密码并点击「登录」；密码只进目标进程内存。/ After verifying the window, the program fills the password and clicks Log On; the password exists only in the target process memory.
会话窗口出现即登录成功。/ The session window appearing means logon succeeded.

elements.text: 说明：自 SAP GUI 7.40 PL1 起，.sap 文件中的密码字段已被官方禁用（SAP Note 146173），因此密码必须在登录框阶段注入。/ Note: since SAP GUI 7.40 PL1 the password field inside .sap files has been officially disabled (SAP Note 146173); the password is therefore injected at the logon-dialog stage.
10.2 若仍弹出登录框 / 10.2 If the Logon Dialog Still Appears
说明密码已送达但被 SAP 拒绝。按可能性排序：

items: 密码已过期（最常见）——右键连接 →「编辑凭据」更新密码。/ Password expired (most common) — update it via right-click → “Edit Credentials”.
账号被锁定——连续输错触发，表现为「刚才还能登，突然全部不行」；请联系 BASIS 管理员解锁。/ Account locked after repeated failures; contact your BASIS administrator.
选错了账号——右键菜单「以 XX 登录」可核对本次所用账号。/ Wrong account selected — check the “Log on as XX” entries.
客户端不对——同一账号在不同客户端是独立存在的。/ Wrong client — the same account name may exist independently in other clients.

elements.text: 原因确认：日志位于 %LOCALAPPDATA%\SapLauncher\logs\，失败时会记录当时屏幕上的对话框标题——出现「修改密码」即密码到期；仅有系统名则为密码错误或账号锁定。状态栏提示条也会直接给出结论。

To confirm the cause, check the logs in %LOCALAPPDATA%\SapLauncher\logs\. Dialog titles are recorded on failure: “Change Password” indicates expiry; a bare system name indicates a wrong password or a locked account. The status bar also reports the conclusion.
10.3 常见问题 / 10.3 Frequently Asked Questions

pairs.key: 未检测到 SAP GUI / Not detected
pairs.value: 未安装 SAP GUI 或安装在被裁剪的非标准目录。程序已覆盖注册表与标准路径查找；仍失败请安装 SAP GUI for Windows / SAP GUI is not installed or is in a non-standard directory; install SAP GUI for Windows

pairs.key: 列表里没有系统 / Empty list
pairs.value: 点「自动获取现有配置」（F5）；确认 SAP Logon 里能看到条目；查看 logs 中的同步警告 / Press F5; verify entries exist in SAP Logon; check sync warnings in logs

pairs.key: 连到另一套系统 / Wrong system
pairs.value: SAP Logon 中存在同名显示名。本程序按显示名精确定位，请勿手工改乱名称 / Duplicate display names in SAP Logon; keep display names unique

pairs.key: 点击登录没反应 / No reaction
pairs.value: 查看状态栏与日志。常见原因：服务器不可达、账号被锁、需要先改密码 / Check the status bar and logs; typical causes: unreachable server, locked account, password change required
被其它程序占用；在设置中更换组合后重启程序 / The hotkey is taken by another program; reassign it in Settings and restart

pairs.key: 关闭窗口后找不到程序 / Window lost
pairs.value: 默认最小化到托盘；双击托盘图标或按热键呼出，可在设置中关闭该行为 / The window minimizes to the tray by default; reopen via tray icon or hotkey
程序会调用 SAP 官方程序并写临时文件；请加入信任，或在设置中关闭「允许密码出现在命令行」/ The program invokes official SAP binaries and writes temporary files; add it to the trust list

elements.text: 11. 导出、导入与分享 / 11. Export, Import & Sharing

items: 导出：设置 → 数据与诊断，生成 JSON。默认仅含连接信息；勾选「包含凭据」时需设置导出密码，凭据单独加密后写入。/ Export: Settings → Data & Diagnostics produces JSON. Connection data only by default; enabling “include credentials” requires an export password and encrypts credentials separately.

导入：先预览（新增 / 覆盖 / 跳过），可勾选「覆盖同名连接」「同时导入分组」；导错可在设置里回滚快照。/ Import: preview first (add / overwrite / skip), with options to overwrite same-name connections and import groups; a snapshot rollback is available if something goes wrong.
分享：右键连接 →「复制连接信息」，生成不含密码的文本卡片，可直接粘贴到即时通讯工具。/ Share: right-click → “Copy connection info” produces a password-free text card ready to paste into a chat tool.

elements.text: 12. 脚本管理 / 12. Script Management
登录成功后可自动执行 SAP GUI 脚本（VBScript）：右键连接 →「绑定脚本…」→「新建脚本」或「导入 .vbs」；编辑器内可「试运行」，保存后点「绑定到当前连接」。下次登录检测到会话窗口后，按绑定顺序用 cscript 执行。

SAP GUI scripts (VBScript) can run automatically after a successful logon: right-click a connection → “Bind Script…”, then create a new script or import a .vbs file. Scripts can be trial-run in the editor and bound to the connection; they execute via cscript once the session window appears.
需要服务器端启用 sapgui/user_scripting = TRUE，且客户端勾选「启用脚本」。不满足时脚本会失败并提示，但不影响正常登录。
Requires sapgui/user_scripting = TRUE on the server and “Enable scripting” on the client. If not satisfied the script fails with a notice but normal logon is unaffected.
13. 快捷键 / 13. Keyboard Shortcuts

rows: 自动获取现有配置 / Sync from SAP Logon
聚焦搜索框 / Focus the search box
登录当前选中项 / Log on the selected item
全局快速搜索窗 / Global quick-search window
清空搜索或关闭快速搜索 / Clear search or close quick search

elements.text: 快速搜索窗：输入名称或 SID，↑↓ 选择，Enter 立即登录，Esc 关闭。全局热键可在设置中修改。
Quick search: type a name or SID, choose with ↑↓, press Enter to log on, Esc to close. The global hotkey is configurable in Settings.
14. 数据存储与迁移 / 14. Data Storage & Migration
14.1 数据位置 / 14.1 Data Location
默认数据目录：%LOCALAPPDATA%\SapLauncher（便携模式下为 exe 同级的 data\ 目录）。
Default data directory: %LOCALAPPDATA%\SapLauncher (the data\ folder next to the executable in portable mode).

pairs.value: 连接清单、分组与设置（不含密码）/ Connections, groups and settings (no passwords)
AES-256-GCM 加密的凭据库 / AES-256-GCM encrypted credential vault
DPAPI 封装的「记住主密码」（不可跨机使用）/ DPAPI-wrapped “remember master password” (not transferable)
VBS 脚本库 / VBScript library
日志，按日轮转保留 7 天 / Logs, rotated daily and kept for 7 days
同步快照，保留最近 5 份 / Sync snapshots (last 5 kept)

elements.text: 14.2 换电脑迁移 / 14.2 Migrating to Another PC

items: 整包便携（推荐）：启用便携模式后，把「exe + data」文件夹整体拷到新电脑。/ Portable (recommended): after enabling portable mode, copy the exe plus data folder.
复制数据目录：把 %LOCALAPPDATA%\SapLauncher 整个文件夹复制到新电脑同一路径。/ Copy the data directory to the same path on the new PC.
导出 / 导入：在程序里导出（可勾选包含凭据）→ 拷到新电脑 → 导入。/ Export (optionally with credentials) and import on the new PC.

elements.text: 凭据用主密码加密；「记住主密码」绑定当前 Windows 账户（DPAPI），换电脑后首次需重新输入一次主密码。迁移后如连接列表不对，先在设置里点「自动获取现有配置」同步本机 SAP Logon。

Credentials are encrypted with the master password. “Remember master password” is bound to the Windows account (DPAPI); the master password must be entered once on the new PC. If the list looks wrong after migration, run “Sync from SAP Logon” in Settings first.
15. 隐私与免责声明 / 15. Privacy & Disclaimer

items: 所有数据保存在本机，不上传、不联网校验。/ All data is stored locally; nothing is uploaded or verified online.
本工具为独立开发的第三方软件，与 SAP SE 无任何关联；SAP、SAP GUI 为 SAP SE 的商标。/ This is an independently developed third-party tool, not affiliated with SAP SE. SAP and SAP GUI are trademarks of SAP SE.

请遵守你所在企业的信息安全规定；如需更高合规级别，可关闭「记住密码」，改为每次由 SAP 弹出登录框。/ Comply with your organization's security policies. For stricter compliance, disable “remember passwords” and let SAP show the logon dialog each time.

elements.text: 16. 从源码构建 / 16. Build from Source
需要 .NET 8 SDK。在项目根目录执行：
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File build\publish.ps1
产物输出至 dist\SAP登录管理器.exe（自包含单文件，原生库与 exe 同目录）。也可双击「一键打包.bat」自动完成清理与打包。

Requires the .NET 8 SDK. Run the command above in the project root; output goes to dist\SAP登录管理器.exe (self-contained single file with native libraries alongside). Alternatively, double-click “一键打包.bat” for a one-shot clean build.
